day_shape: 66 items: Witkoff-Kushner Iran talks set for Doha Tuesday with $6-12bn frozen-asset figure floated, Khamenei funeral logistics dominate regime channels, IDF strikes 3 Hezbollah sites in southern Lebanon, CENTCOM commander tours Beirut, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Doha talks and frozen assets
threads.summary: The White House confirmed Witkoff and Kushner will attend an Iran meeting in Doha on Tuesday, with technical teams working on an interim MoU. Pezeshkian told state media Iran would receive $6-12 billion in frozen assets, while Judiciary Chief Mohseni Ejei said Iran would pursue US asset seizure cases.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral arrangements
threads.summary: IRIB announced farewell ceremonies at Imam Khomeini Square from Saturday 13 Tir through the Tehran funeral on Monday 15 Tir, with 24-hour banking and traffic plans published. Iran International reported public satire over the delayed burial, and Reza Pahlavi called for a 'Global Week of Action for a Free Iran' to coincide.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz mine clearance
threads.summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi said on Defa Press and IRIB that mine clearance in the Strait of Hormuz will be carried out solely by Iran under the Islamabad memorandum, rejecting Macron's offer of partner coordination. Oman's Foreign Ministry said the joint Omani-Iranian committee held its first Muscat meeting on the Strait.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon strikes and framework
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck three Hezbollah command centres in Nabatieh and Mayfadoun and dismantled a launcher, while a reservist was severely wounded by a blast in Arnoun. Defence Minister Katz said Israel will only partially withdraw pending Hezbollah disarmament; CENTCOM's Adm. Brad Cooper met President Aoun and LAF chief Haykal on the Washington framework agreement.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and hostage politics
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said Ismail Masri, head of Hamas military security in the Rafah Brigade, was killed in a strike last Tuesday, and Islamic Jihad's Zaher Abu Salem, who took part in October 7 abductions, was killed Sunday. Finance Minister Smotrich cancelled a planned visit to Kibbutz Be'eri after relatives of 32 hostages protested his claim of a critical role in their return.

threads.label: Domestic Iranian regime moves
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Iran's judiciary issued an indictment against Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi and several media figures linked to the January protests that reportedly killed 40,000 Iranians. IRGC spokesperson Mohebbi played down Pezeshkian's claim of allocating 20 million barrels of oil to the IRGC Aerospace Force, and an Israeli official said Iranian cyberattacks have risen sharply.
